title: 第一卷 第14章 主要是你脸比较配合
slug: 全网黑上恋综后我爆红了
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

工作人员把他们带到夜市中央的灯牌前。

灯牌上写着几个字。

“今晚心动营业中。”

宋尔尔看完，评价：“这牌子很会自我欺骗。”

陆执：“哪里欺骗？”

宋尔尔：“营业是真的，心动待定。”

工作人员假装没听见。

摄影师站好位置，提醒：“两位可以自然一点。”

宋尔尔：“自然是最难演的。”

陆执看她：“你不是不喜欢演？”

宋尔尔：“所以我更难。”

摄影师说：“陆老师先指导尔尔老师一个动作吧。”

宋尔尔站在灯牌下，看着陆执。

“陆老师，请。”

陆执走到摄影师旁边，认真看了看镜头。

“往左一点。”

宋尔尔往左挪。

“再靠近灯牌一点。”

宋尔尔靠近。

“看镜头。”

宋尔尔看镜头。

“笑一下。”

宋尔尔扯了下嘴角。

陆执沉默。

宋尔尔：“怎么？”

陆执：“像准备投诉。”

宋尔尔：“那是我最真诚的笑容。”

陆执：“再真诚一点。”

宋尔尔：“三十块不包含情绪增值服务。”

陆执看着她，忽然说：“烤冷面加蛋。”

宋尔尔立刻笑了。

摄影师手快，咔嚓一声拍下来。

照片里，宋尔尔站在灯牌下，眼睛微弯，笑得少见地轻松。

陆执看着相机屏幕，没说话。

宋尔尔走过来：“怎么样？”

陆执：“不错。”

宋尔尔低头一看。

确实不错。

她有点意外。

照片里的她不像黑料里那个总是表情尖锐的宋尔尔，也不像公司通稿里那个没礼貌的宋尔尔。

就是她自己。

放松的，真实的，还有点馋加蛋烤冷面的她。

宋尔尔抬头看陆执。

“陆老师，你很懂诱导消费。”

陆执：“有效就行。”

工作人员提醒：“现在轮到尔尔老师指导陆老师。”

宋尔尔立刻来了精神。

“陆老师，站过去。”

陆执走到灯牌下。

他个子高，站在那里不用摆什么动作都好看。

这就是很烦人的地方。

有些人连努力都显得多余。

宋尔尔绕着摄影师看了看。

“陆老师，往右一点。”

陆执照做。

“低头。”

陆执低头。

“看镜头。”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

The staff took them to the light sign in the center of the night market.

There are several words written on the light sign.

"Heartbeat is open tonight."

After reading it, Song Er'er commented: "This brand is very good at self-deception."

Lu Zhi: "Where is the deception?"

Song Er'er: "The business is real, my heartbeat is to be determined."

The staff pretended not to hear.

The photographer stood up and reminded: "You two can be more natural."

Song Er'er: "Of course it is the most difficult to act."

Lu Zhi looked at her: "Don't you like acting?"

Song Er'er: "So it's more difficult for me."

The photographer said: "Teacher Lu, let's teach Teacher Er'er a movement first."

Song Er'er stood under the light sign and looked at Lu Zhi.

"Teacher Lu, please."

Lu Zhi walked to the photographer and looked at the camera carefully.

"Move to the left."

Song Er'er moved to the left.

"Get closer to the light sign."

Songer came closer.

"Look at the camera."

Songer looked at the camera.

"Smile."

Song Er'er twitched the corner of his mouth.

Lu Zhi was silent.

Song Er'er: "What?"

Lu Zhi: "As if preparing to file a complaint."

Song Er'er: "That is my most sincere smile."

Lu Zhi: "Be more sincere."

Song Er'er: "Thirty yuan does not include emotional value-added services."

Lu Zhi looked at her and suddenly said: "Toast cold noodles with eggs."

Song Er'er smiled immediately.

The photographer was quick and took the picture with a click.

In the photo, Song Er'er is standing under the light sign, with slightly curved eyes and a rare relaxed smile.

Lu Zhi looked at the camera screen and said nothing.

Song Er'er came over and said, "How's it going?"

Lu Zhi: "Not bad."

Song Er'er looked down.

Not bad indeed.

She was a little surprised.

In the photo, she doesn't look like the Song Er'er who always has a sharp expression in the black material, nor does she look like the impolite Song Er'er in the company's press release.

Just herself.

She is relaxed, real, and a little greedy for baked cold noodles with eggs.

Song Er'er looked up at Lu Zhi.

"Teacher Lu, you know how to induce consumption."

Lu Zhi: "As long as it works."

The staff reminded: "Now it is Teacher Er'er's turn to guide Teacher Lu."

Song Er'er immediately became energetic.

"Teacher Lu, stand over."

Lu Zhi walked under the light sign.

He is tall and looks good standing there without any movements.

This is where it gets really annoying.

For some people, even their efforts seem redundant.

Song Er'er looked around the photographer.

"Teacher Lu, go a little to the right."

Lu is allowed to do it.

"Lower your head."

Lu Zhi lowered his head.

"Look at the camera."
